**Build log: Agent Instructions** (built by Claude Opus 5.5, in Claude Code)

Built as the plan says. Nothing is committed yet; resolving this thread accepts it.

**The link** (`src/Instructions.js`, new; attached in `src/Server.js`)
- `GET /instructions` answers `text/plain; charset=utf-8` with no token needed.
- It puts a **This server** section first, made on each request: the API address, built from the request's own `Host` (so it is whatever address the session used); the `llm` participant's token; and the header to send it in.
- The guide follows, read from `.guides/build-with-consensus.md` on each request, so an edit to the guide shows at once.

**The listen address** (`src/Server.js`, `bin/consensus.js`)
- The server listens on the `--host` option, else `Host` in `consensus.json`, else `127.0.0.1`. A new settings file gets `"Host": "127.0.0.1"`.
- Any address is accepted: the refusal of other hosts is gone. `0.0.0.0` listens on every interface, and the printed address then says `127.0.0.1`.
- At start the server prints the address it listens on. When that is beyond this machine, it adds a warning that anyone who can reach it acts as the owner and can read the token at `/instructions`.

**The guide** (`.guides/build-with-consensus.md`)
- It opens with how to read it (with `curl`).
- **Talking to Consensus** now points at This server instead of `~data`, says everything goes through the API, and gives Calling the API with the curl example.
- New sections: **Finding your project**, **Loading your context**, **What the owner's words mean**, and **Drafting a plan**. "Your turn" gains Comment and resolve, and the build loop commits "in your own repo".
- Two things beyond the plan's list, because a session elsewhere cannot read `src/Api.js`:
  - The routes list replaces "the routes are in src/Api.js". It gains projects (list and create), creating a plan, and re-anchoring.
  - A line says an anchor's text is matched without markdown marks. I learned that the hard way this session.

**Readme**
- **Starting it** covers `--host`, the relaxed security, and the one line that starts an agent session.
- **Settings** shows `Host`, and the code layout lists `src/Instructions.js`.

**Tests**: `npm test` passes all 153 tests.
- `test/Api.test.js`, the start test: Host 127.0.0.1 is written and used; `0.0.0.0` from the option is accepted and answers at 127.0.0.1; `localhost` comes from the settings.
- A new instructions test: plain text; This server first, with the address the request reached (checked with a made-up `Host` header) and the llm token; the guide's text at the end.

**To try it**: restart the Consensus server, then give a session this line: "read the instructions at http://127.0.0.1:3500/instructions with curl". For a session on another machine, set `Host` (or `--host`) first.
